method: Exact scaled-integer arithmetic, no floating point: for each amount string, record and strip a leading '-', let d = number of fractional digits and N = the non-negative integer formed by concatenating integer and fractional digits (the amount in units of 10^-d). If d <= 2, M = N * 10^(2-d) with no rounding. If d > 2, with k = 10^(d-2), q = N div k, r = N mod k, half = 5*10^(d-3): M = q when r < half, M = q+1 when r > half, and on an exact tie (r = half) M = q if q is even else q+1 (round-half-to-even). M is the amount in whole hundredths; I = M div 100, C = M mod 100 rendered as two digits; I is comma-grouped every three digits from the right, '.' and C appended, and negative amounts wrapped in parentheses. Full per-item table of N, d, q, r, half, M is in child-derivation.md; every d>2 input here was an exact tie (r = half = 5), decided by the parity of q.
